name: The Hunt Begins
summary: Young hunters at Camp Narache gather food and feathers for their people. Grull Hawkwind asks you to hunt plainstriders on Red Cloud Mesa, where the village depends on what the young can provide.

sections.title: A Tribe's Sustenance
sections.body: On Red Cloud Mesa, the tauren hunt to feed and clothe their people. They also value the stalk and chase as a test of discipline and a sport. When Camp Narache's stores run low, the young hunters gather plainstrider meat for cooking and feathers for tribal garments.

sections.title: Earning Recognition
sections.body: Grull Hawkwind judges the newcomers who hope to leave Red Cloud Mesa for the wider plains of Mulgore. Before they can meet his father, Chief Hawkwind, he asks them to prove their ability. A successful hunt shows self-reliance and helps support the tribe.

faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind gives you this work in Camp Narache. He is Chief Hawkwind's son and guides young hunters on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why are plainstriders hunted instead of other beasts?
faq.answer: Plainstriders are plentiful on the mesa. Their meat helps replenish low food stores, and their feathers are used in traditional tauren clothing and adornments.

faq.q: Why do I have to prove myself before seeing Chief Hawkwind?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind asks you to show basic survival skills and loyalty to the village before you meet Chief Hawkwind and take on deeper responsibilities.

faq.q: What is the broader goal of these trials on Red Cloud Mesa?
aliases: why am i on red cloud mesa
faq.answer: Red Cloud Mesa tests young tauren before they descend to Mulgore's wider plains and enter Thunder Bluff, the capital city.

aliases: what is after the hunt begins
faq.answer: After you bring back meat and feathers, Grull approves your hunt and sends you to track larger, harder-to-find game across the mesa.

faq.q: Do tauren only hunt for survival?
faq.answer: Tauren hunt for food and resources such as leather, bone, and feathers, and also for sport and spiritual communion. Hunting sharpens the instincts that keep their tribes alert and strong.

angles.text: As a young shu'halo, your first hunt for plainstriders on the mesa marks your bond with the land and your duty to feed Camp Narache.
As a hunter, you practice marksmanship and tracking while hunting the swift plainstriders of Red Cloud Mesa, and learn to honor the beasts that sustain you.
